faqs.question: What is your Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.answer: Our standard MOQ starts at 10,000 cans per flavor/strength combination for Private Label projects. For custom R&D contract manufacturing formulations, MOQs may vary based on ingredient sourcing.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get product samples?
faqs.answer: For standard private label stock flavors, sample pucks are dispatched within 5-7 business days. Custom formula R&D samples typically take 10-14 business days.

faqs.question: What is your typical mass production lead time?
faqs.answer: Once artwork and initial samples are approved, our standard production lead time is 2 to 3 weeks for domestic dispatch from our Phoenix plant.

faqs.question: Can we supply our own active ingredients or flavors?
faqs.answer: Yes! We accommodate client-supplied materials (Customer Furnished Materials) subject to our Incoming Quality Control (IQC) testing and COA verification.

faqs.question: Do you offer full custom label design and packaging?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our design team can provide exact print templates for cans, catch-lids, shrink bands, and counter displays, or assist in finalizing your brand artwork.

faqs.question: Are your manufacturing facilities FDA registered?
faqs.answer: Yes. Phoenix Pouch Co. operates an FDA registered facility in Phoenix, Arizona, adhering to cGMP standards under 21 CFR Part 111 & Part 117.

processSteps.title: Raw Material Inspection
processSteps.subtitle: Incoming Quality Control (IQC)
processSteps.description: Every ingredient—nicotine, active nootropics, natural flavors, and food-grade non-woven pouch material—is quarantined upon arrival. Independent HPLC testing verifies 99%+ active ingredient purity before release.
details: Accredited raw material COA compliance check

processSteps.title: Formulation & Blending
processSteps.subtitle: High-Shear Homogenization
processSteps.description: Ingredients are precisely weighed in cleanroom environments and homogenized using high-shear stainless steel industrial mixers to guarantee uniform active dose distribution across every micro-gram.

processSteps.title: Pouch Forming & Dosing
processSteps.subtitle: Automated Ultrasonic Pouching
processSteps.description: State-of-the-art automated pouching lines form, dose, and ultrasonically seal food-grade non-woven pouches at speeds up to 1,200 pouches per minute with +/- 0.01g weight precision.

processSteps.title: Can Filling & Sealing
processSteps.subtitle: Puck Assembly & Catch-Lid Press
processSteps.description: Pouches are automatically counted (15, 20, or custom counts) and loaded into polypropylene cans. Top lids and catch-lid waste compartments are mechanically pressed and hermetically sealed.

processSteps.title: Labeling & Packaging
processSteps.subtitle: 360° Branding & Shrink Banding
processSteps.description: High-speed wrap-around labeling machinery applies pressure-sensitive or metallic foil labels to cans. Laser inkjet encoders apply lot codes, and tamper-evident shrink bands are heat-sealed.

processSteps.title: Final QC
processSteps.subtitle: Outgoing Quality Control & Retention
processSteps.description: QA inspectors pull finished samples from every master lot for final weight, label accuracy, microbial purity, and active dosage testing. Official Certificate of Analysis (COA) is issued for each batch.

processSteps.title: Shipping
processSteps.subtitle: Climate-Controlled Dispatch
processSteps.description: Finished goods are stored in climate-controlled warehousing in Phoenix, Arizona (65-72°F) ready for palletized freight shipping, express delivery, or international container export.
details: US domestic freight & export customs docs
Custom drop-shipping to brand distribution hubs
